question: Identify the top 10 liquor categories in Iowa in 2021 by calculating, for each category, the average of the per-liter retail prices across all sales transactions in that category during 2021. For these top categories, provide their average per-liter retail prices calculated in the same manner for the years 2019, 2020, and 2021.
sql:
WITH per_category_yearly AS (
  SELECT 
    category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as yr,
    AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(sale_dollars, volume_sold_liters)) as avg_per_liter_price
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    AND volume_sold_liters > 0
  GROUP BY category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    category_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN avg_per_liter_price END) as avg_per_liter_price_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN avg_per_liter_price END) as avg_per_liter_price_2020,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2021 THEN avg_per_liter_price END) as avg_per_liter_price_2021
  FROM per_category_yearly
  GROUP BY category_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    category_name,
    avg_per_liter_price_2019,
    avg_per_liter_price_2020,
    avg_per_liter_price_2021,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_per_liter_price_2021 DESC) as rn
  FROM pivoted
)
SELECT category_name, avg_per_liter_price_2019, avg_per_liter_price_2020, avg_per_liter_price_2021
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY rn
